audit.whatIsWrong: Six of the seven chart rows disagreed with the sentence printed beside them. Levels 3 and 4-5 were scored Shen while whys[2] and whys[3] both describe Lillia grinding him down; Level 6, first item and 2+ items were scored Lillia/Shen while whys[4], whys[5] and whys[6] all say 'even'. diff also read HARD against tone, diffRating 4/10 and breakdown.difficulty 'Favoured'.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Skill, Skill, Lillia, Lillia, Skill, Skill, Skill — which matches the prose exactly. The chart tokens were the part that was wrong.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 proposed as matched full+content pairs to land on the packet chart, ratings adjusted, and diff aligned to FAV.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was framed as Lillia's spike via ganks; Shen's level 6 is the larger spike and it is not a lane spike at all.
audit.why: Stand United is 35000 range on a 200/180/160s cooldown — it decides fights on the other side of the map, which is why the stage is even rather than yours.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now points the reader at his ult timer instead of promising guaranteed ganks.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tracked only Shadow Dash. It never mentioned Twilight Assault, which is the ability that actually beats Lillia, and never mentioned that Stand United is a channel.
audit.why: Twilight Assault deals max-health damage, is greatly empowered when the spirit blade collides with a champion, and its slow applies only to enemies running away from Shen — it is purpose-built to end a kite, on a 5-8s cooldown against Shadow Dash's 10-18s. Stand United is flagged as an interruptible channel, so hard CC cancels the save; Lilting Lullaby is hard CC.
audit.corrected: Twilight Assault's run-away slow added to report[5].t and mid with the advice to kite sideways rather than straight back; the channel interaction added to late; Shadow Dash's real cooldown added.

audit.why: The existing line that Spirit's Refuge blocks your autos but not your ability DoT is right — Riot's text blocks attacks only — and it is the best thing on the page. Left untouched.

edits.before: Q's outer ring on his last-hits plus the passive speed means he literally cannot touch you at level 1.
edits.after: One ability each and no kite chain yet — last-hit from the Q edge and concede the opening minute.

edits.before: Lilting Lullaby online — your jungler's ganks are now guaranteed, and any overstep becomes a sleep-execute.
edits.after: Lullaby sets up ganks, but Stand United swings fights map-wide — track his ult timer, not his lane.

edits.before: Liandry's spike — Dream Dust plus the burn melts juggernauts and tanks alike while you jog circles around them.
edits.after: Liandry's makes the burn bite his HP stack, but Ki Barrier and tank stats mean you chunk him, never kill.

edits.before: You're a teamfight nightmare now: sleep two, kite the rest, and let the burn do the bookkeeping.
edits.after: You out-skirmish him; he out-teamfights you — taunt and global protect what your sleep cannot.

edits.before: His taunt engage — punish hard while it is on cooldown. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Shadow Dash is 18s at rank 1 — bait it, count it, then ring him for the downtime.

edits.before: Track Shen’s Shadow Dash (Taunt): His taunt engage — punish hard while it is on cooldown. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Shadow Dash (18s at rank 1), and fear Twilight Assault: its slow applies only while you run away from him — built to end your kite.

edits.before: Full-rank Q and the compounding burn grind down a Shen who must walk at you, hold E Swirlseed to peel his taunt dash.
edits.after: Full-rank Q and compounding burn grind down a Shen who must walk at you; hold Swirlseed for his 14s taunt dash.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your best lane window: full Q rank and the burn compounding mean you grind down a Shen who has to walk at you, and his passive shield can't keep pace if you keep the DoT ticking. The catch is his E taunt — if he lands it mid-kite he gets a free Q-empowered trade, so hold your E Swirlseed to slow-and-peel the moment he dashes. At 6 his global R matters more than his lane: he can vanish to save bot, so ping and track his ult.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your best lane window: full Q rank and the burn compounding mean you grind down a Shen who has to walk at you, and Ki Barrier can't keep pace if you keep the DoT ticking. The real catch is Twilight Assault — max-health damage, empowered when the spirit blade clips you, and its slow only applies while you run away from him, so kite sideways rather than straight back. Hold Swirlseed for his 14s Shadow Dash. At 6 track his global, not his lane.

edits.before: This stays even into the late game. You never hard-lose the 1v1 but you also can't kill a tanky Shen outright, and his global R plus E taunt make him a teamfight machine that ignores your single-target sleep. Your job is to convert your 4-to-first-item burn lead into roams and map pressure before his utility takes over, sleep-isolate his carry in fights and let your DoT do work while his taunt is committed elsewhere.
edits.after: This stays even late. You never hard-lose the 1v1 but you also can't kill a tanky Shen outright, and his global R plus taunt make him a teamfight machine your single-target sleep ignores. Stand United is a channel, though — hard CC cancels it, so a landed Lilting Lullaby on a channelling Shen deletes the save. Convert your burn lead into roams before his utility takes over, and sleep-isolate his carry while his taunt is committed elsewhere.

edits.before: Land E taunt-dash to lock your kite and let his Q-empowered autos punish through W's auto-block
edits.after: Land Shadow Dash, then Twilight Assault — its slow only bites while you are running away

notes: Lillia's E carries a derived 'terrain — creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes' flag, but Riot's own Swirlseed text only says the seed rolls until it hits a wall or a target. I treated the flag as a tooltip-parsing misfire and did NOT write anywhere that Swirlseed can wall off Shadow Dash. Worth checking centrally, since that flag will tempt every Lillia agent into the same false claim. The Stand United channel-cancel line is High confidence on the kit flag ('channel: interruptible — any CC cancels it') but I have not verified whether Drowsy alone interrupts before the sleep lands, so the text says a landed Lullaby, not the wind-up.
